name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AdminConfigIT
comment: Admin configuration screens of Settings (TC-CFG-NNN). Changes shared reference data, so it gets its own database.

methods.name: listsTerms
methods.comment: TC-CFG-002: Terms list with string ids, windows and status labels.

methods.name: termValidationNamesFields
methods.comment: TC-CFG-003 (negative): missing and inconsistent windows are named per field.

methods.name: publishTermLifecycle
methods.comment: TC-CFG-004: a Draft is invisible to students and takes the default Deposit window; publishing shows it; a second publish and an overlapping Term are refused.

methods.name: roomTypes
methods.comment: TC-CFG-005: Room Types with inventory counts; mutual invite only for 2 Beds; names are unique.

methods.name: roomTypeBedsChangeTheInventory
methods.comment: TC-CFG-006: changing the Beds of a Room Type adds or retires Beds in its Rooms.

methods.name: roomClasses
methods.comment: TC-CFG-007: Room Classes show where they are used and the deposit rate; the surcharge is bounded.

methods.name: feesAndRefundRules
methods.comment: TC-CFG-008: fees and refund rules save as one document; a new rule gets an id; bad rates are refused.

methods.name: eligibilityRules
methods.comment: TC-CFG-009: criteria switches and priority groups (order, new group, member counts).

methods.name: matchingSnapshots
methods.comment: TC-CFG-010: weights must total 100%; saving creates the next snapshot; a dry run allocates nothing.

methods.name: systemParameters
methods.comment: TC-CFG-011: system parameters are typed; an invalid value is named by its key.

methods.name: utilityPolicy
methods.comment: TC-CFG-013: Admin › Utility loads with its option lists, rejects values outside them and audits a change.

methods.name: managerCannotConfigure
methods.comment: TC-CFG-012 (permission): a Manager cannot open Admin configuration.

methods.name: term
methods.signature: term(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.Integer)
methods.comment: A complete Term; registration closes before the stay, results a week later, Balance due before Check-in.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AdminUsersIT
comment: Admin › Users and Roles, permission matrix, Audit Log, and the invite → set password → change password flow.

methods.name: listsBackOfficeUsersWithFilters
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-011: the list holds back-office accounts only, with labels and string ids; filters by role and Block.

methods.name: invitedUserSetsAndChangesPassword
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-012: an invited Staff sets the password from the emailed link (one use only), signs in with the Block scope, and a password change keeps the current session but signs out the others.

methods.name: inviteIsValidated
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-013 (negative): invite validation names each field.

methods.name: disablingRevokesSessions
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-014: disabling a user signs them out at once and is written to the Audit Log.

methods.name: adminCannotDisableThemselves
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-015 (negative): the Admin cannot lock themselves out.

methods.name: staffCannotManageUsers
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-016 (permission): Staff cannot open Admin screens.

methods.name: permissionMatrixComesFromTheRuleTable
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-017: the permission matrix is the enforced rule table.

methods.name: auditLogListsSignIns
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-018: Audit Log filters, labels and retention; a bad range is refused.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.ApplicationsIT
comment: Application wizard, roommate pairs, cancellation and expiry (TC-APP-NNN). Each test uses its own students.

methods.name: catalogAndEligibility
methods.comment: TC-APP-001: the student's Term is the open one; catalog prices and eligibility for it.

methods.name: submitsApplicationWithDeposit
methods.comment: TC-APP-002: submit with a Deposit Invoice, then the list, detail, Home and notification; a second one is refused.

methods.name: applicationIsValidated
methods.comment: TC-APP-003 (negative): contact, consent and roommate rules are named per field.

methods.name: roommateCheckIsPrivacySafeAndLimited
methods.comment: TC-APP-004 (privacy): the same answer for every unusable code, and a limited number of checks.

methods.name: invitedPairIsSubmittedTogether
methods.comment: TC-APP-005 (business rule): an invited pair reaches the office together: the first to pay waits as Awaiting Roommate; both are Submitted when the second Deposit is paid.

methods.name: declinedInvitationFallsBackToAutomaticMatching
methods.comment: TC-APP-006: a declined invitation leaves the inviter matched automatically.

methods.name: cancellationVoidsOrRefunds
methods.comment: TC-APP-007: cancelling voids an unpaid Deposit; a paid one is refunded by the rule; the student may apply again.

methods.name: unpaidApplicationExpires
methods.comment: TC-APP-008 (job): an unpaid Application expires when its Deposit window passes; its Invoice is voided.

methods.name: applicationsArePrivate
methods.comment: TC-APP-009 (permission): Staff cannot use student screens; another student's Application is 404.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.ApplyFlow
comment: Helpers for the Application and payment integration tests: a published Term whose registration is open now (so tests do not depend on the seed's dates), submitting an Application and paying through the SePay webhook.

methods.name: openTerm
methods.comment: Publishes the test Term once; registration opened yesterday and closes in 30 days.

methods.name: body
methods.comment: Body of {@code POST /applications}; {@code roommate} is raw JSON or null.

methods.name: sepay
methods.comment: What SePay posts for a transfer to the receiving account.

methods.name: pay
methods.comment: Pays the Invoice exactly, as the bank feed would report it.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AssignmentIT
comment: Staff review, the assignment run, conflicts, the Manager's approval and the student's Room (TC-APP-010…011, TC-ASG-010…012). Each test uses its own students.

methods.name: submitted
methods.comment: Applies for a 2-bed Standard Room and pays the Deposit: the Application is Submitted.

methods.name: reviewQueueAndRejection
methods.comment: TC-APP-010: the queue, the review view (opening it starts the review), rejection needs a note, once only.

methods.name: reviewIsScopedByBlock
methods.comment: TC-APP-011 (scope): a Block B Manager never sees Block A students; students cannot use the queue.

methods.name: assignmentRunToAllocation
methods.comment: TC-ASG-010: approve in bulk, run, resolve the conflict to the waitlist, submit the Block, the Manager returns it once and then approves: Allocations, Balance Invoices, notifications and My Room.

methods.name: dryRunAndPermissions
methods.comment: TC-ASG-011: a dry run is a preview; students and other Blocks cannot use runs.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.AuthFlowIT
comment: End-to-end Auth flow against a real PostgreSQL with the Flyway schema and dev seed. Test case IDs follow TC-AUTH-NNN (Report 5).

methods.name: signInReturnsTokenAndUser
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-001: valid credentials return a token and the contract user shape.

methods.name: wrongPasswordAndUnknownEmailLookTheSame
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-002: wrong password and unknown email get the same generic answer.

methods.name: signOutRevokesToken
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-003: me works with the token; after sign-out the same token gets 401.

methods.name: roleRulesAreEnforced
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-004: no token → 401; a student calling an Admin endpoint → 403.

methods.name: accountLocksAfterMaxFailedAttempts
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-005 (boundary): the 5th wrong password locks the account, even for the right password.

methods.name: invalidBodyReturnsFieldErrors
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-006 (negative): body validation returns field messages.

methods.name: termsAreListed
methods.comment: TC-CFG-001: published Terms with string ids, ISO dates and the list total.

methods.name: forgotPasswordIsSilent
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-007: forgot password never reveals whether the email exists.

methods.name: rememberIsOptional
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-008: "remember" may be left out (Jackson 3 would reject a missing primitive).

methods.name: googleNeedsExactlyOneOfCodeAndCredential
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-009 (negative): Google sign-in needs exactly one of code and credential.

methods.name: googleDisabledWithoutConfiguration
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-010: without Google configuration both flows answer 503 GOOGLE_SIGN_IN_DISABLED.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.BlockSettingsIT
comment: Block Manager › Block settings, inside the Admin limits (TC-CFG-014, 015).

methods.name: readAndSave
methods.comment: TC-CFG-014: the Block's settings and the Admin limits; the Manager saves a change, which is audited.

methods.name: rejectsValuesOutsideTheLimits
methods.comment: TC-CFG-015 (negative): values outside the Admin limits or out of order are named per field; Manager only.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.BlockStaffIT
comment: Block Manager › Staff: who works in the Block, what they handle, duty, account requests (TC-AUTH-019…021).

methods.name: listsTheBlocksStaff
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-019: the Block's staff with titles, handles, Blocks, open work and duty; the summary.

methods.name: updatesHandlesAndDuty
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-020: the Manager sets what a person handles and their duty; only staff who share a Block.

methods.name: requestsANewAccount
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-021: the Manager asks Admin for a new account in the Block; one waiting request per email.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.DeskIT
comment: The Check-in and Check-out desk (TC-ASG-020…023). Each test allocates its own students.

methods.name: allocate
methods.comment: Applies, pays the Deposits, approves, runs and commits Block A: the students hold Beds, Balance unpaid.

methods.name: checkInNeedsBalanceAndUtilityDeposit
methods.comment: TC-ASG-020: the Balance includes the Utility Deposit; until it is paid the desk blocks check-in; then the student checks in with the hand-over items, once only.

methods.name: deskIsScoped
methods.comment: TC-ASG-021 (scope): another Block's desk does not find the student; students and the Admin have no desk.

methods.name: checkOutSettlesTheDeposit
methods.comment: TC-ASG-022: check-out settles the Utility Deposit: the share since the Room's last reading, the damage charge, the refund to the Manager; the Bed is free again and the figures stay as settled.

methods.name: shortfallIsInvoiced
methods.comment: TC-ASG-023: when the charges exceed the Utility Deposit, the rest is invoiced to the student.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.DevicesIT
comment: FCM device tokens and push after commit (TC-NTF-020, 021); FCM itself is a recording stand-in.

methods.name: registerAndUnregister
methods.comment: TC-NTF-020: register, register again, unregister; the token is stored by hash and validated.

methods.name: pushAfterCommit
methods.comment: TC-NTF-021: a notification is pushed to the user's devices after commit; an expired token is disabled.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.EscalationIT
comment: Requests past their timers escalate to the Block Manager, who hands them on (TC-REQ-016…018).

methods.name: reportedHoursAgo
methods.comment: Moves the report back in time, as if it had waited that long.

methods.name: maintenanceEscalatesAndIsReassigned
methods.comment: TC-REQ-016: an unassigned request escalates, then passes its timer; the Manager reassigns it once.

methods.name: escalationClosesWhenTheRequestIsAssigned
methods.comment: TC-REQ-017: an escalation closes by itself once the request is back on track.

methods.name: roomChangeEscalatesAndGetsATemporaryBed
methods.comment: TC-REQ-018: an undecided Room-Change Request escalates; the Manager offers a temporary Bed; Manager only.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.FinanceIT
comment: Block Finance: overdue Invoices and reminders, figures, refunds (TC-BIL-020, 021).

methods.name: overdueAndReminders
methods.comment: TC-BIL-020: an unpaid Balance past its due date becomes Overdue (the student is told); the Block Manager sees it with the days overdue and sends a reminder, in-app and by email.

methods.name: refundDecisions
methods.comment: TC-BIL-021: refunds wait for the Block Manager; rejecting needs a note; the student is told.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.InspectionIT
comment: Inspections: checklists (Admin), schedules (Block Manager) and runs (Staff) (TC-MNT-004…007).

methods.name: checklistsAreVersioned
methods.comment: TC-MNT-004: the seeded checklist; a Draft is published as v1; editing publishes v2 and keeps v1 as Replaced.

methods.name: scheduleAndRun
methods.comment: TC-MNT-005: a schedule starts its first run at once and notifies residents; Staff record the Rooms, a failed item creates a Maintenance Request with the severity's priority; the run is submitted; the job starts the next.

methods.name: archivingPausesSchedules
methods.comment: TC-MNT-006: archiving a checklist pauses its schedules, which cannot resume until another is published.

methods.name: permissions
methods.comment: TC-MNT-007 (permission): schedules are the Block Manager's, in their Block; runs need Staff.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.InventoryIT
comment: Admin › Buildings and Staff/Manager › Inventory (TC-INV-NNN).

methods.name: listsBuildingsAndFloors
methods.comment: TC-INV-001: Blocks with their Floors, Room counts per Room Type and closed Rooms.

methods.name: createsBlockAndGeneratesRooms
methods.comment: TC-INV-002: a new Block gets the standard layout; generating again adds nothing; bad ranges are refused.

methods.name: structureFollowsBlockScope
methods.comment: TC-INV-003 (scope): Staff see only their Blocks; a Block outside the scope is refused.

methods.name: showsFloorWithOutOfServiceRoom
methods.comment: TC-INV-004: a Floor's Rooms and Beds with the out-of-service details.

methods.name: occupiedRoomIsProtected
methods.comment: TC-INV-005 (business rule): an occupied Room cannot go out of service, its Block cannot change gender and its Room Type cannot change Beds; the occupant shows on the Bed.

methods.name: outOfServiceAndBack
methods.comment: TC-INV-006: out of service and back, with the reason label, who set it, and the Audit Log.

methods.name: studentsCannotSeeInventory
methods.comment: TC-INV-007 (permission): students cannot see the inventory; unknown Rooms are 404.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.LateCheckInIT
comment: Late check-ins: recorded at the desk, decided by the Block Manager (TC-ASG-030, 031).

methods.name: approvedLateCheckIn
methods.comment: TC-ASG-030: Staff record the request with evidence; the Block Manager approves a deadline, after which the desk lets the student check in even though the Term's window is closed.

methods.name: rejectedLateCheckIn
methods.comment: TC-ASG-031: a rejection needs a reason; another Block's Manager does not see the request.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.LayeringTest
comment: Calls go one way, controller → service → repository / entity (ADR-17, architecture §5): controllers never reach the database themselves, and nothing below the controllers depends on them.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.MaintenanceIT
comment: Maintenance Requests from the student's report to the confirmed fix (TC-MNT-001…003).

methods.name: livesIn
methods.comment: The student holds the Bed and has checked in (the desk is tested in DeskIT).

methods.name: studentReportsAndFollows
methods.comment: TC-MNT-001: a checked-in student reports with photos and follows the request; the form is validated.

methods.name: staffWorkTheRequest
methods.comment: TC-MNT-002: Staff of the Block assign, plan the visit, post updates and resolve; the student is notified, reopens once and confirms the fix. Photos open through signed links.

methods.name: queueIsScoped
methods.comment: TC-MNT-003: the queue is scoped: another Block's Manager neither sees nor counts the request.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.MessagingIT
comment: Admin › Notification templates and Send email (TC-NTF-030…033).

methods.name: editsTemplates
methods.comment: TC-NTF-030: templates with their variables and sample values; the push limit and unknown variables.

methods.name: sendsATestToTheAdmin
methods.comment: TC-NTF-031: a test sends the unsaved text, with sample values, to the signed-in Admin.

methods.name: previewsAnEmail
methods.comment: TC-NTF-032: options leave system emails out; the preview counts the group and renders the first email.

methods.name: sendsAnEmail
methods.comment: TC-NTF-033: sending queues one email per student (and the in-app notice with push); validation; Admin only.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.MeterIT
comment: Monthly meter readings and Utility Invoices (TC-BIL-023…026).

methods.name: residentsWithLastMonth
methods.comment: Two residents of a Room, and last month's closed reading of that Room (1,000 kWh, 40 m³; it used 100 kWh).

methods.name: periodsAndReadings
methods.comment: TC-BIL-023: the current month opens on first use; Rooms with residents wait for a reading.

methods.name: readingRules
methods.comment: TC-BIL-024: a reading may not go back; an unusual jump waits for a confirmation.

methods.name: importCsv
methods.comment: TC-BIL-025: a CSV import checks every line before it saves any.

methods.name: closeIssuesUtilityInvoices
methods.comment: TC-BIL-026: closing the month issues each resident's Utility Invoice with its breakdown; then it is read-only.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.NotificationsIT
comment: Notification Center (TC-NTF-NNN). Each test uses its own student so the unread counts do not mix.

methods.name: listsLatestWithUnreadCount
methods.comment: TC-NTF-001: newest first, with the unread count and string ids; {@code limit} caps the items.

methods.name: marksReadOnlyOwnNotifications
methods.comment: TC-NTF-002: mark one read (twice is fine), then all; someone else's notification is 404.

methods.name: requiresSignIn
methods.comment: TC-NTF-003 (negative): signed-in users only.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.PasswordFlowIT
comment: Password reset (from the emailed link) and password change, against a real PostgreSQL. The raw reset token is only in the email, so tests read it from the notification outbox row. Each test uses its own seed account. Test case IDs follow TC-AUTH-NNN (Report 5).

methods.name: resetChangesPasswordAndRevokesSessions
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-022: reset sets the new password, the old one fails and every earlier session is signed out.

methods.name: resetLinkCannotBeReused
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-023 (negative): a reset link works only once.

methods.name: resetRejectsWeakPasswordAndKeepsLink
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-024 (negative): a weak new password is refused and the link stays usable.

methods.name: changeRejectsWrongCurrentPassword
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-025 (negative): a wrong current password is a field error and changes nothing.

methods.name: changeKeepsCurrentSessionAndRevokesOthers
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-026: change keeps the current session, signs out the others and the new password works.

methods.name: changeRejectsWeakPassword
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-027 (negative): change refuses a weak new password and keeps the old one.

methods.name: requestResetToken
methods.comment: Asks for a reset link and reads the raw token from the email queued in the same transaction.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.PaymentDeskIT
comment: Staff › Payments: the scoped list with its summary and manual confirmation (TC-BIL-010…012).

methods.name: scopedListWithSummary
methods.comment: TC-BIL-010: the Block's Invoices with filters and the summary; another Block's Manager does not see them.

methods.name: manualConfirmation
methods.comment: TC-BIL-011: Staff confirm a transfer by hand with the bank reference and a receipt; the amount must be exact; the Application is submitted as with VietQR; a second confirmation is refused.

methods.name: manualConfirmationRules
methods.comment: TC-BIL-012: with manual confirmation turned off (Admin › Fees) only VietQR settles Invoices; files are sniffed.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.PaymentsIT
comment: Student Invoices, the VietQR payment page, the SePay webhook and receipts (TC-BIL-NNN).

methods.name: depositInvoiceAndPaymentPage
methods.comment: TC-BIL-001: the Deposit Invoice in the list, its detail and the VietQR payment page; the QR can be refreshed.

methods.name: webhookNeedsApiKey
methods.comment: TC-BIL-002 (security): the webhook refuses a missing or wrong API key.

methods.name: exactTransferPaysOnce
methods.comment: TC-BIL-003 (business rule): an exact transfer pays the Invoice once, even when SePay delivers it twice; the Application is submitted and a PDF receipt is available.

methods.name: wrongAmountWaitsForConfirmation
methods.comment: TC-BIL-004: a wrong amount does not pay the Invoice; it waits for Staff confirmation.

methods.name: codeInMemoAndUnmatchedTransfers
methods.comment: TC-BIL-005: the code found in the transfer memo when SePay sends none; unknown codes stay unmatched.

methods.name: invoicesArePrivate
methods.comment: TC-BIL-006 (permission): another student's Invoice is 404; the Admin may read it.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.PostgresTestcontainer
comment: One PostgreSQL 17 container for integration tests (needs Docker).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.ReportIT
comment: Dashboards, reports and exports, read from the reporting views (TC-RPT-001…008, TC-RPT-010, TC-RPT-011).

methods.name: staffDashboard
methods.comment: TC-RPT-001: Staff dashboard: the review queue, Rooms out of service, the Block's Beds, what needs attention.

methods.name: managerDashboard
methods.comment: TC-RPT-002: Block Manager dashboard: occupancy by floor, the SLA rate and target, what is waiting.

methods.name: approvalCounts
methods.comment: TC-RPT-003: the Manager's approval counts; Staff may not see them.

methods.name: adminDashboard
methods.comment: TC-RPT-004: Admin dashboard: the Term, people, the funnel, Blocks, configuration checks and integrations.

methods.name: occupancyReport
methods.comment: TC-RPT-005: occupancy by Block, Room Type and Room Class; capacity leaves Rooms out of service out.

methods.name: financialReport
methods.comment: TC-RPT-006: money per Block; Deposits of students without a Bed have a row of their own.

methods.name: blockReport
methods.comment: TC-RPT-007: the Block report counts check-ins per week and who has not checked in yet.

methods.name: pastTermReports
methods.comment: TC-RPT-010: a Term that has ended still reports who lived there (Allocations ended by check-out, not by a room change), and a refunded Deposit without a Bed counts in the row of its own.

methods.name: dashboardsBeforeTheFirstTerm
methods.comment: TC-RPT-011: before the first Term is published the dashboards and approval counts answer with empty figures (the Admin's checks still list what to set up); an unknown Term and the reports still answer 404.

methods.name: exports
methods.comment: TC-RPT-008: exports are CSV files with the screen's columns, written to the Audit Log; scope and permissions.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.RoomChangeIT
comment: Room-Change Requests from the student's request to the Staff decision (TC-REQ-001…003).

methods.name: studentAsks
methods.comment: TC-REQ-001: the options, a request for a cheaper Room Type, one open request per Term; validation.

methods.name: staffApprove
methods.comment: TC-REQ-002: Staff of the Block approve with a free matching Bed: the student moves; a cheaper Room is credited to the student, a dearer one is invoiced.

methods.name: staffReject
methods.comment: TC-REQ-003: a rejection needs a listed reason; the student sees it.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.Round2IT
comment: Round 2 for Waitlisted students: held options, accept, decline and expiry (TC-APP-020, 021).

methods.name: round2Lifecycle
methods.comment: TC-APP-020 and TC-APP-021: three Waitlisted students each get held options in partly filled Rooms. One accepts (Allocated with a Balance), one declines and one does not answer: both are cancelled and their paid Deposits wait as refunds for the Block Manager.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.RoutingIT
comment: Block Manager › Routing rules and escalation timers; new requests follow the rules (TC-REQ-013…015).

methods.name: rulesAndTimers
methods.comment: TC-REQ-013: rules, gaps and timers of the Block; validation; Manager only, in scope.

methods.name: maintenanceFollowsTheRules
methods.comment: TC-REQ-014: a new Maintenance Request goes to the category rule first, else All; off duty → fallback.

methods.name: roomChangesFollowTheRules
methods.comment: TC-REQ-015: a Room-Change Request goes to the Block's rule and is due after the Block's timer.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.StayFlow
comment: Helpers for tests during the stay: students who hold a Bed, through the real flow or a direct row.

methods.name: livesIn
methods.comment: A checked-in Bed without the assignment run (desk and assignment are tested elsewhere).

methods.name: runRound1
methods.comment: Applies for the Room kind and pays the Deposit for each student, approves them, runs and commits Block A after moving every conflict to the waitlist, and the Block Manager approves.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.SwapIT
comment: Bed swaps: direct invitations, the swap board, the Staff and Manager decisions (TC-REQ-010…012).

methods.name: directSwap
methods.comment: TC-REQ-010: a direct swap: the partner accepts, Staff check and approve, the two students change Beds.

methods.name: swapBoard
methods.comment: TC-REQ-011: the swap board: an anonymous post, a matching request, then the dearer Bed is invoiced and the other student credited; a Bed the post does not want is refused.

methods.name: crossBlockGoesToManager
methods.comment: TC-REQ-012: a swap across Blocks goes from Staff to the Block Manager, who decides it last.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.TestAuth
comment: Sign-in helpers for integration tests (seed accounts share one password).

methods.name: bearer
methods.comment: Signs in and returns the {@code Authorization} header value.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.security.SecurityConfigCorsTest
comment: CORS origins for the deployed web app (ADR-16). Test case IDs follow TC-AUTH-NNN (Report 5).

methods.name: admitsExactOriginAndPreviewPattern
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-016: an exact origin and a Vercel preview pattern are both admitted.

methods.name: refusesOtherOriginsAndBlankSetting
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-017 (negative): other origins are refused, and a blank setting keeps CORS closed.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.assignment.AssignmentEngineTest
comment: The rule-based engine alone, without a database (TC-ASG-001…006).

methods.name: pairFirstIntoEmptyTwoBedRoom
methods.comment: TC-ASG-001: an invited pair shares an empty 2-bed Room; the next student gets NO_BED when none is left.

methods.name: ineligibleStudentIsFlagged
methods.comment: TC-ASG-002: a student who is no longer eligible is flagged and never placed.

methods.name: partnerNotReady
methods.comment: TC-ASG-003: an invited partner who is not in the run blocks the pair (PARTNER_NOT_READY).

methods.name: bestFitRoom
methods.comment: TC-ASG-004: a single student joins the Room whose occupant shares the most attributes.

methods.name: priorityOrderAndDeterminism
methods.comment: TC-ASG-005: the priority group goes first; the same input gives the same proposal.

methods.name: lowFitIsInformation
methods.comment: TC-ASG-006: a placement with few shared attributes is kept and marked LOW_FIT (information only).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.auth.GoogleCodeExchangerTest
comment: Google authorization-code exchange (ADR-14). Test case IDs follow TC-AUTH-NNN (Report 5).

methods.name: exchangesCodeForIdToken
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-011: the code is posted with the popup redirect URI and the ID token is returned.

methods.name: usedCodeIsInvalid
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-012 (negative): a used or expired code is the user's retryable error (401).

methods.name: wrongClientSecretIsUnavailable
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-013 (negative): a wrong client secret is our misconfiguration, not the user's (503).

methods.name: networkFailureIsUnavailable
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-014 (negative): Google cannot be reached (503).

methods.name: codeFlowNeedsClientSecret
methods.comment: TC-AUTH-015 (boundary): without a client secret the code flow is off and Google is never called.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.billing.UtilitySplitTest
comment: How a Room's meter is split between its residents (TC-BIL-022).

methods.name: equalSharesForTheWholeMonth
methods.comment: TC-BIL-022: residents who lived in the Room the whole month pay equal shares.

methods.name: aCheckOutSplitsTheMonthIntoSegments
methods.comment: TC-BIL-022: a check-out cuts the meter; the leaver's share is marked settled (paid from the Utility Deposit).

methods.name: sharesFollowTimeInTheRoom
